question: What is the meaning of ionizing radiation in relation to environmental performance?
description: Ionizing radiation refers to the type of radiation that has enough energy to remove tightly bound electrons from atoms, thus creating ions. In the context of environmental performance, ionizing radiation is considered a potential risk to human health, indicating the presence of radioactive materials in the environment. This characteristic is part of the predetermined environmental essential characteristics related to life cycle assessment, highlighting the importance of assessing and managing radioactive contamination to protect human health and the environment.
